content.value_statement: Generic AI-generated interfaces often look crowded, glossy, or inconsistent. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code precise visual rules for calm editorial layouts.
actual_capabilities: Defines a warm monochrome color palette with muted pastel accents.
Specifies typography rules for sans-serif, serif, and monospace UI text.
Guides bento grid cards with crisp borders, generous spacing, and flat surfaces.
Sets constraints for buttons, tags, accordions, keyboard shortcuts, and window mockups.
Directs subtle motion using transform and opacity instead of layout-changing animation.
Rejects common generic SaaS styling patterns such as heavy shadows and bright gradients.
limitations: It is a design directive, not a component library or runnable application.
It does not provide accessibility testing, browser testing, or responsive QA by itself.
It may need adjustment for brands that require bright colors or expressive illustrations.
It suggests placeholder imagery when real assets are unavailable.

use_cases.title: Create a calm product landing page
use_cases.description: Use the skill to guide a landing page with restrained colors, strong typography, bento feature grids, and subtle motion.

use_cases.title: Refine an AI-generated dashboard
use_cases.description: Apply the visual constraints to remove generic SaaS styling and produce a flatter, more editorial interface.

use_cases.title: Standardize a design prompt library
use_cases.description: Use the rules as a repeatable visual language for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code frontend generation tasks.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a simple landing page
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new page.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a minimalist landing page for a productivity app using this skill. Use warm monochrome colors, editorial typography, and a bento feature section.

prompt_templates.title: Redesign an existing interface
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for improving a current UI.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this interface and restyle it with the minimalist editorial rules. Remove heavy shadows, bright gradients, generic fonts, and crowded spacing.

prompt_templates.title: Build a dashboard layout
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for structured product UI.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a dashboard with flat cards, crisp borders, muted tags, clear typographic hierarchy, and subtle transform-based motion.

prompt_templates.title: Create a full frontend implementation
prompt_templates.prompt: Implement a responsive React page using this skill. Include the palette, typography hierarchy, bento grid, accordions, keyboard shortcut styling, and restrained animations.

output_examples.input: Design a documentation homepage for a developer tool.
output_examples.output: A calm documentation homepage with a serif hero heading, narrow readable text width, flat bordered cards, muted status tags, and subtle section reveal motion.

output_examples.input: Make this SaaS dashboard feel less generic.
output_examples.output: A revised dashboard direction that removes heavy shadows and bright colors, adds warm neutral surfaces, improves spacing, and uses quiet bento-style information groups.

output_examples.input: Create UI guidelines for a premium workspace product.
output_examples.output: A concise visual system covering off-white backgrounds, charcoal text, restrained pastels, crisp borders, editorial headings, and low-distraction motion.

best_practices: Provide the product context, target audience, and page type before asking for a design.
Ask for accessibility and responsive behavior checks after the first visual pass.
Pair the skill with real brand assets when placeholder images are not acceptable.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for neon gradients, glossy glassmorphism, or loud SaaS styling while using this skill.
Do not mix many unrelated typefaces or icon sets in the same interface.
Do not treat the generated design as production-ready without testing usability and responsiveness.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps AI tools create minimalist editorial web interfaces with refined typography, flat surfaces, and restrained colors.

faq.question: Does this skill include runnable code?
faq.answer: No. It is a design and implementation directive that guides generated frontend code or layout decisions.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. It is intended for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code when generating or refining frontend interfaces.

faq.question: Is it suitable for colorful consumer brands?
faq.answer: It may need adaptation. The skill is optimized for warm monochrome interfaces with scarce pastel accents.

faq.question: Does it handle accessibility automatically?
faq.answer: No. You should still request accessibility checks for contrast, focus states, semantic markup, and keyboard behavior.

faq.question: Why were security findings marked false positive?
faq.answer: The flagged text is Markdown design guidance, inline CSS examples, and UI terminology. It is not executable code or malicious behavior.
